items: Creatures pull faces: an enraged one glares with its brows down, a party animal (or a friendly area's creature) beams with its eyes closed in smiling arcs, and a stunned one looks dazed with crossed-out or odd eyes
The faces are part of each creature, not marks over its head, and each family has its own: feathery brows on birds and bats, brow ridges on snakes and beetles
